name: Familiar Foe

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

prerequisites: expert in Religion or Undead Lore
text: You regularly face off against undead and can identify many with a glance. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on skill checks to Recall Knowledge about undead. Whenever you roll a critical failure on a check to Recall Knowledge about undead, you get a failure instead.
